old world

Prevention is failing

Attackers will get in. And it’s never been easier. In a cloud-first world where vulnerabilities run wild across SaaS, Cloud, and Identities, the doors are open wide to attackers. Add AI to the mix, and it’s the perfect storm.

NEW world

Zero-Impact Breach Prevention

Mitiga AI-native Zero-Impact Breach Prevention is a radical shift from the empty promise of zero breach to a promise we can actually keep: zero impact. Now you’re empowered to step in during the breach, stop attackers in their tracks, and undo the harm before it matters.

The AI-native platform

Mitiga’s Zero-Impact Breach Prevention platform gives a full view of your ecosystem, provides detailed information on all attacker behavior, and stops attacks in their tracks.

Panoramic awareness
Attack decoding
Attack mitigation

See everything as one

Panoramic awareness

Capture live activity across Cloud, SaaS, AI and Identity—not as scattered fragments, but as one coherent, living system.

Trace the full story

Attack decoding

Reconstruct every action, log, and signal into a unified attack sequence. Decode early-stage attacker behavior to predict where they’re headed.

Cut the infiltration chain

Attack mitigation

Sever attack momentum at its weakest point – stopping escalation before impact takes hold.

OUR AIDR

The Zero-Impact Engine

Our platform's AI-native engine is your secret weapon to defend AI infrastructure, while empowering your SOC and stopping AI-fueled attacks faster than humanly possible.

Always in command

Turns alert floods into clear priorities – automating triage and accelerating investigations so your SOC leads every response, not chases it.

Always strike-ready

Supercharges threat detection with AI-powered analysis and pattern-level precision – so AI-fueled attacks get found and crushed before they spread.

Always airtight

Shields your AI-ecosystem from prompt injection, data leaks, and model tampering – locking down your AI services so nothing slips through.
